items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And he says, 'You're right, Sal. Well, excuse me. I'm getting old, and I kind of forget' ... But they loved him, man.

ctx.x: We go in the back, and we sit back there: [SINGS] "(?) Marie, (?) Marie..." And he sings it wrong, and they look at him. And they help him. "No, Billy, that's not it." [SINGS REFRAIN]...whatever that is. And he says, "You're right, Sal. Well, excuse me. I'm getting old, and I kind of forget" -- something, you know. But they loved him, man. We'd eat that artichoke, and we'd get that spaghetti that comes in big old tub -- a tub of spaghetti
